title: Love the evolution of @Hot Mess the Musical ❤️‍🔥 so much!
transcript: Just got out of Hot Mess here at the Other Palace. This is my fourth time seeing a Hot Mess, but my first time seeing this version. Hot Mess was one of my favourite shows at fringe last year. And y'all, this version is bigger and better than ever before. They have added at least 20 minutes to the show, including two new songs and a bunch of book editions. It feels so much more complex and well rounded. I love the changes that they've made. This truly has gone from a fringe show to what feels like a fully fledged production. And not just in the writing and the overall direction, but the, the design of the show is bigger and better. Set design is pretty much the same, but a little more polished. And yet it works so well, especially with the added lighting effects, the additional costumes. Danielle Steers reprises her role as the Earth in this romantic comedy between earth and humanity. And Morgan Gregory is the new addition joining the cast as Humanity. The two of them have incredible chemistry together and really have you rooting for this relationship. And with the additional 25 minutes, you feel their arc and the, the development of their relationship so much more. And of course, you have these absolutely incredible songs by Jack Godfrey and Ellie Coote. I, I love, I love this score so much. You can listen to the full cast recording on all streaming platforms. We have also released one of the new songs performed by Morgan Gregory called one in a trillion that you can stream now. So if you don't believe me, go at least listen to the cast album. As far as tickets go, I was invited to this, but there are still very incredibly affordable tickets available to go see this at The Other Palace, as cheap as £15 through the rest of the run. It does close September 6th, so you do not have much longer to see it here, but I do hope that it has further runs elsewhere, including New York. Bring. Bring this to New York. Bring this to New York.
